name: JAZ-X PHP Security Guardian
author: jazxinnovation

sections.description:
JAZ-X PHP Security Guardian is a free administrator-only security advisory dashboard. It helps site owners check whether their PHP version meets the upstream fixes published on October 21, 2026 for CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619.

Features:

  • Shows PHP runtime version and compares it to the published patched releases for PHP 8.2, 8.3, 8.4, and 8.5.
  • Warns administrators when their PHP release is below the upstream fix threshold.
  • Provides links to official PHP security guidance.
  • Shows cached WordPress core, theme, and plugin update counts.
  • Shows WP_DEBUG and PHP display_errors configuration status.
  • Lets administrators record a hosting provider’s written backport or mitigation statement without treating it as independently verified.
  • Optionally sends administrator emails when a potentially affected PHP runtime is newly detected or its reported version changes, using WordPress cron.
  • Keeps all checks read-only; no automatic file modifications, remote scans, or PHP version changes.

Important limits:

  • This plugin does NOT patch PHP vulnerabilities or block exploit traffic. Some exploits can run before WordPress loads.
  • A version-number comparison alone cannot determine whether a host has vendor backports or external mitigations.
  • A patched PHP version does not imply a WordPress site is entirely secure.
  • The included CVE thresholds are a reviewed static snapshot, not a live vulnerability database. Future advisories require plugin updates.
  • WordPress cron depends on site activity and is not a guaranteed exact-time security alert mechanism.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP using Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate JAZ-X PHP Security Guardian.
  3. Open Tools > PHP Security Guardian.
  4. Review the PHP report and contact your hosting provider for any vendor-specific patch/backport confirmation.
  5. Optionally save a hosting response and configure email alerts.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin fix CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619?

No. Only a security-patched PHP runtime (including correctly applied, vendor-supported backports) addresses the underlying problem. This plugin is a monitoring and guidance tool.

Is the PHP version warning proof my host is exploitable?

No. Some hosts use security backports or other controls which a WordPress plugin cannot verify. Ask your provider for a written statement and prioritize a supported patched runtime.

Does it send any site information to an outside service?

No. This version has no external telemetry or vulnerability scanning API calls. WordPress’ own built-in update checking operates separately. Optional alert emails go to the site’s configured administrator address.

Does it modify PHP or WordPress settings?

No. Checks are read-only, except plugin preferences and alert state stored locally in the WordPress options table.
